The '''''Emerald'' arc''' (Japanese: '''エメラルド編''' ''Emerald arc''), also referred to as '''''The Sixth Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第六章''' ''The Sixth Chapter''), is the sixth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, consisting of four volumes. It began serialization in February 2005, and ended in October 2008.

The arc begins with focus on a {{pkmn|Trainer}} named {{adv|Emerald}}, who is sent by [[Professor Oak]] and {{adv|Crystal}} to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} {{adv|Jirachi}} within seven days. On arrival at the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}, he ends up interfering in the opening ceremonies and gains the second challenge of clearing the seven [[Battle facility|battle facilities]] by defeating the [[Frontier Brain]]s within that time. During this time, Emerald befriends [[Todd Snap]] and discovers that the armored villain [[Guile Hideout]] is seeking Jirachi for his own evil purposes.

== Terminology ==
{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
{{main|Timeline of events in Pokémon Adventures#Emerald arc|Timeline of events in the Emerald arc of Pokémon Adventures}}
* A few months have passed since the end of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}.
* {{adv|Emerald}} arrives at the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}} and crashes the opening ceremony, after which the [[Frontier Brain]]s challenge him to defeat all seven facilities in seven days.
* {{p|Latias}} and {{p|Latios}} are revealed to be helping Emerald.
*Emerald reveals that his task is to capture {{adv|Jirachi}}.
* [[Guile Hideout]] appears with Jirachi in [[Artisan Cave]]. Jirachi runs away and Guile escapes.
* {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} arrive at the Battle Frontier and meet Emerald.
* Guile Hideout captures Jirachi.
* It is revealed that the Pokédex Holders who had been petrified at the end of the previous arc have been brought to the Battle Frontier. 
* Guile Hideout's [[Archie|identity]] is revealed, and Jirachi grants his wish. A {{p|Kyogre}}-shaped creature appears by the Battle Frontier.
* {{adv|Gold}} and {{adv|Crystal}} appear.
* Emerald's past is revealed.
* The petrified Pokédex Holders are freed by Jirachi.
* The monster Kyogre is destroyed by the ten Pokédex Holders.
* The mystery behind Archie's armor and sword is revealed, after which he disappears.
* Emerald achieves his goals.
* Jirachi returns to sleep.
* [[Professor Oak (Adventures)|Professor Oak]] and Crystal call [[Professor Rowan]].

==Trivia==
* When this arc was being published in the magazines, it was known as the Battle Frontier arc (Japanese: '''バトルフロンティア編''' ''Battle Frontier chapter''). At the time, this arc was the only arc of Pokémon Adventures not named after a game.
